newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Corp starts gas oil imports from S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Corp starts gas oil imports from S.Korea.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corp has started importing gas oil by procuring a 5,000-kilolitre cargo from Hyundai Oil Refinery Co, traders with the Japanese trading house and the South Korean refiner said on Thursday.
"We imported our first cargo from Hyundai earlier this month, and will soon be importing another one from another South Korean supplier," a Mitsubishi Corp trader said.

The trading firm was authorised by the government to become a gas oil wholesaler earlier this year, and the terms of the approval require the company to import at least 50,000 kilolitres of gas oil per year.
Before the authorisation, Mitsubishi Corp had been active in arranging gas oil imports for domestic refiners.
The Mitsubishi trader also said the firm will start importing gas oil with sulphur content of less than 0.05 percent as early as June.
Japan will cut the maximum allowable sulphur content in gas oil to 0.05 percent in October from the current 0.2 percent.
